patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Office Timeline and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Frame: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Office Timeline and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.. Choose Office Timeline only if your buying job matches “PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite fro” rather than Smartsheet's shape. Choose Smartsheet only if your buying job matches “Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/memb” rather than Office Timeline's shape. Workflow advantage: Office Timeline leans shared coverage; Smartsheet leans work-management, resource-planning. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Office Timeline and Smartsheet share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Office Timeline is PowerPoint-native timeline / Gantt specialist (now Lucen Timeline) — Free add-in; Lite from $9/user/mo annual.; Smartsheet is Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro from $9/member/mo annual..
- Workflow coverage skew: Office Timeline-leaning — vs Smartsheet-leaning work-management, resource-planning.
- Researched limits: Office Timeline — Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management; Smartsheet — No free plan.

Limitations — Office Timeline: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management; Centre of gravity is PowerPoint presentation timelines, not live team task execution; Smartsheet: No free plan; Business tier pricing jump.

Poor-fit cases: Office Timeline is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a work OS — no monday/Hive-class boards, automations or workload management · Smartsheet is a poor fit when that limitation bites: No free plan · Avoid Office Timeline if you actually need Smartsheet's motion (Spreadsheet-style work management with Gantt, portfolios and automation — Pro fr)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
